thread:
nora: Quick notify: Hosted Streaming + Tool-Calling is GAing tonight at 20:00 PT. This release focuses on safer tool integ, adaptive-region failovers, and a consolidated streaming runtime. Docs & migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/streaming-toolcall-ga :tada:
devin: Do customers need to rotate keys or change endpoints?
nora: No endpoint changes for basic streaming. New tool-calling schema is optional but recommended. SDK helpers available in js/py 0.13.x.
sre-bot: Rollout window 20:00-21:00 PT. Regions: us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. Canary keys in place. Auto-pause triggers: streaming-err-rate > 0.6% or p95 > 360ms.
lj: Note for Dedicated: pinned variants keep precedence unless you toggle "allow_adaptive_routing" on your routing policy. We'll email affected accounts.
nora: Also adding a default concurrent stream cap of 50 streams/org to protect noisy neighbors; support can adjust per contract.
support_sam: We'll send CS the one-page migration checklist and a short explainer for customers using external webhooks. Important: whitelisted callback domains only.
devin: For observability — will Console include a per-region fallback graph?
nora: Yes, new "Streaming" dashboard shows per-region p50/p95/p99, fallback-count, and token-level cost estimates.
sre-bot: SRE will run a short burn-in during rollout that exercises KV-cache hot paths. If rollback occurs, ops will open an incident thread in #incidents.
lj: Sample curl for the new optional tool-call attachment (docs):
lj: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-stable-1.2","stream":true,"tools":[{"name":"lookup","url":"https://hooks.example.com/lookup"}]}'
```
cto_jane: Great progress. Please prepare a short exec summary tomorrow AM with initial telemetry highlights.
